description: Create a long-form X Article from markdown. Save as a draft, schedule it for later, or publish immediately. Articles are X's long-form format with rich text, headings, images, and embedded posts. Requires a paid OpenTweet plan and an X account eligible for Articles (any X Premium tier). Markdown supported: # / ## / ### headings, **bold**, *italic*, ~~strikethrough~~, [links](url), bullet/numbered lists, > blockquotes, images via ![caption](url) (uploaded to X automatically), and embedded posts by placing an x.com status URL on its own line. Fenced code blocks are preserved as plain text (X articles have no code formatting).

content_markdown.description: The full article body as markdown

cover_image_url.description: URL of a cover image (shown at the top of the article)

publish_now.description: Publish to X immediately (mutually exclusive with scheduled_date)

scheduled_date.description: ISO 8601 datetime to schedule publishing (mutually exclusive with publish_now)

x_account_id.description: Target X account ID (for multi-account users)

name: opentweet_create_article
